title: Bram and the Protocol
author: L. M. Eastwick
blurb: Wren Sterling, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
